task_management.hero_h1a: A Production Doesn't Need More Tasks.
task_management.hero_sub: Film productions are full of moving pieces. Departments preparing equipment, producers coordinating logistics, directors refining creative decisions. Everyone is busy. Yet no one sees the full picture.
task_management.problem_title: Productions don't struggle with having tasks.
task_management.problem_desc: Most productions rely on improvised systems to manage tasks. Each system works on its own. Together, they create confusion.
task_management.problem_card_title: These are the questions no one can answer.
task_management.problem_q2: Is it finished? Has it even started?
task_management.problem_q4: Which version is the right one?
task_management.problem_tools_footer: …and no one is sure which one is current.
task_management.problem_bottom: This is not a productivity problem. It is a coordination problem.
task_management.core_desc: One platform. The complete production task lifecycle. Everything your team needs — from assignment to completion — in one connected workspace.
task_management.core_feat1_desc: Tasks live inside the same environment as scripts and schedules. No separate tool, no context switching.
task_management.core_feat2_desc: Every task has a named owner connected to a real department, not just a name in a spreadsheet.
task_management.core_feat3_desc: Dates reflect actual production timing because they exist inside the scheduling context.
task_management.core_feat4_desc: AI surfaces dependencies and helps prioritise based on production structure. Humans still make the calls.
task_management.cta_desc: With Pzaz, you know what needs to happen, who is responsible, and how to keep the production moving forward.
